title: DDI-CDI Data Structure Component
description: Role given to a represented variable in the context of a long or wide data structure to identify the units associated to data points, and in dimensional and key value data structures to provide identifying fields for the instance values.

DataStructureComponent.description: Members common to every data structure component. Composed into each component below with allOf; not a component type in its own right, and not a branch of this schema's root anyOf.

cdif:identifier.description: Identifier for objects requiring short- or long-lasting referencing and management.

cdif:isDefinedBy_Variable.description: The variable this component is a role of -- a RepresentedVariable or an InstanceVariable, inline or by @id reference. See the note above $defs.

cdif:semantic.description: Qualifies the purpose or use expressed as a paired external controlled vocabulary.

IdentifierComponent.description: Role given to a represented variable in the context of a long or wide data structure to identify the units associated to data points, and in dimensional and key value data structures to provide identifying fields for the instance values.

MeasureComponent.description: Role given to a represented variable in the context of a data structure to hold the observed/derived values.

cdif:name.description: Human understandable name (linguistic signifier, word, phrase, or mnemonic). May follow ISO/IEC 11179-5 naming principles, and have context provided to specify usage.

AttributeComponent.description: Role given to a represented variable in the context of a data structure to qualify observations or provide other types of supplementary information.

cdif:qualifies.description: The data structure components whose observations this attribute qualifies. Any component except another AttributeComponent, inline or by @id reference.

DimensionComponent.description: Role given to a represented variable in the context of a dimensional data structure to identify the universes associated with data points. The variable acts as a field in the compound identifier (the key structure) to disambiguate the cells in the multi-dimensional "cube".  AG: references to the variables which are the components of a compound identifier, in which each variable is a single field - an axis - in a coordinate system addressing a location in a matrix. These variables are often categorical, but also commonly include time. Unlike other Components, they may be ordered using instances of cdi:ComponentPosition.

cdif:categoricalAdditivity.description: Indicates whether categories at a specific level can be combined to provide the value for their shared parent category. Value is True if categories can be added together (collapsed) to create higher-level categories. An example would be age categories: five-year age categories can be collapsed into 10-year age categories.

VariableValueComponent.description: Role given to a represented variable in the context of a data structure to record values of multiple variables.

VariableDescriptorComponent.description: Role given to a represented variable in the context of a data structure to provide codes for variable identification.

cdif:isDefinedBy_DescriptorVariable.description: Variable that provides codes for variable identification in the context of a data structure. Descriptor Variables hold values which reference the logical variables in the data set, indicating which one the associated value in the corresponding Reference Variable is a measure/value for. Descriptor Variables are presentational variables found only in Long Data Sets. EA models this as its own association (connector 345) rather than a formal redefinition of the inherited isDefinedBy (connector 429), but CDIF treats it as a redefinition: the variable a VariableDescriptorComponent is a role of IS its DescriptorVariable, so the inherited property is disallowed below rather than left available.
